claim_boundary: Storage-design and reconstruction gate only. No 1.58-bit quality or deployment claim is allowed without text, vision, and MTP-aware behavioral evaluation.

parameter_scope.ternary: every rank-2 parameter, including language, vision, MTP, convolution projections, and linear-attention A/B projections
parameter_scope.scale_accounting: all scale bytes and retained BF16 bytes are included in effective bits per original checkpoint parameter

hypothesis: All rank-2 matrices with ideal base-3 codes plus one FP16 scale per output row form a complete parameter payload below 1.60 effective bits per original parameter, and provide the storage target for a later train-aware quality-recovery rung.
selection_rule: Among candidates whose independently recomputed complete rate is at most 1.60 bpp, select the finite candidate with minimum parameter-weighted sample relative-L2 reconstruction error; break ties by lower complete bpp, then candidate name.
sequence: Finish the active group-128 conservative artifact and its quality/QAT pipeline as the protected anchor.
Run a fixed representative reconstruction ablation across language, vision, MTP, convolution, and linear-attention projections.
Do not launch a second full checkpoint pack until the reconstruction receipt identifies a candidate and the current pipeline is terminal.
Require separate text, multimodal, and MTP-aware behavioral gates before any complete-model quality claim.
stop_condition: Stop on inventory drift, effective rate above 1.60, non-finite scales or reconstruction metrics, code mismatch, or missing modality coverage.
